persona: Apparel art director for independent labels

designs.why: Reads instantly from 3 m: three clean ransom-note lines, and the halftone Pluto with its heart is recognisable at a glance. The type mix (slab, blackletter M, grotesk e, stencil-ish D) feels cut out by hand rather than generated. At full size the Pluto halftone is a coarse, even screen (dots around 1.5 mm) that will hold in one white ink, and the letter-scrap dots (around 0.5 mm) are printable. Probe, dotted path and the NEW HORIZONS / 14 JULY 2015 caption add a credible zine-evidence note without crowding. Minor issues: the black gaps in the tape hatching are only about 0.25 mm and will likely fill in with white plastisol, and the left-heavy Pluto block leaves the right column a little thin.
designs.fix: Open the black gaps in the masking-tape hatching to 0.5 mm or more (fewer, thicker stripes) so the tape doesn't flood into a solid white slab on press.
